newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea rumoured to step in, buys dollars.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea rumoured to step in, buys dollars.

text.p: The central bank of Korea was rumoured to have intervened in the interbank market late on Monday morning and bought dollars at around 890.60, dealers said.
The bank, following routine, would not confirm the action.
The won firmed in early morning on expected month-end export deals, traders said.
They said the won started to lose strength against the dollar on the rumoured central bank intervention. The won hit a morning low of 891.20.
The won is currently trading at 891.10.
